_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
I-map la kada letra ed sakey a unikong digit para say arithmetic so tumwak.
I-assign la gamit so `[A 5]`, i-reassign la ninuman.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mali so format na aksyon. Gamit la so `[A 5]`.
invalid_move.digit_used: Say digit {digit} et inusar la na {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Say manunan digit na salita et agnayarin 0.

outcome.incorrect: Akompleto so panag-map balet aliwan susto iray equation.
